title: Pancake totem
description: Changes the totem of undying into a pancake.
body:
This texture pack replaces the totem of undying with a pancake buddy. Any or all models include are made by me and this was made for a special pancake i know very well.
The design includes a stack of pancakes, two blue berrys for eyes, and lastly a bananna plus top includes some melted butter.
